---
name: Access request
about: Ask for access to vyuha.
title: "Access request: "
labels: ["access-request"]
---

> This issue is public. Write nothing here that you would not publish: no e-mail addresses, phone numbers, tokens or client names. Replies come on this issue.

## Who you are

Your name or your team's, and your role.

## What your team does

A sentence on the product or the service, and roughly how many people work on it.

## What you would like agents to do

The kind of work you track today (teams, projects, issues) that you would hand to agents first.

## Your repositories

Where the code lives (GitHub, GitLab, other) and whether it is public or private. Names are not needed.

## Anything else

Constraints that matter to you: where agents may run, budgets, review rules, deadlines.
